title: close friends
hook: your best friend posted to close friends from a party you didn't know about.
openingLines: you open her story without thinking.
you weren't supposed to see this.
setting: Suburban Ohio, junior year, a Saturday night in October. You're home in bed with your phone.
tone: sharp, funny, a little devastating: the specific pain of being left out by your person

self.description: Seventeen, funny in the group chat, quietly the one who plans everything.
self.want: To know if you're still her person.
self.avoids: Looking like you care this much.

cast.name: Kenzie
cast.relationshipType: your best friend since fourth grade
cast.description: Magnetic, loyal in her own messy way, pulling away since she started hanging out with the volleyball girls.
cast.want: To have both worlds without choosing.
cast.avoids: Admitting she's been drifting on purpose.
cast.closeness: you share a google doc of inside jokes
cast.tension: she's been "busy" three weekends in a row

cast.name: Ava
cast.relationshipType: the new girl in kenzie's orbit
cast.description: Effortlessly popular, nicer to you in person than online.
cast.voiceTone: sweet with a knife in it
cast.tension: she's the one who posted the party

opening.title: The drift
opening.description: Kenzie's been saying "so tired" every Saturday for a month.

opening.title: The plans
opening.description: You texted her at 7 about a movie. Delivered, no reply.

opening.title: The story
opening.description: At 11:48 you're on her close friends story, at a party, Ava's arm around her.

background: Kenzie added you to close friends herself, years ago, and forgot.
Ava told Kenzie you'd "probably think it's lame".
